---
name: Skill request
about: Suggest a skill to add to the registry
labels: skill-request
---

**Skill name**
What should the skill be called?

**Source**
Where does this skill come from? (ClawHub URL, GitHub repo, etc.)

**Category**
Which category fits best? (software-dev, blockchain, ai-agents, devops, etc.)

**Description**
What does this skill help an AI agent do?

**Why is it useful?**
Who would use this and for what task?
